description.value: Saha Eatery is a Squamish restaurant drawing on Silk Road culinary traditions, combining Lebanese and Middle Eastern flavours with ethically sourced meats, grains, and legumes prepared from scratch daily. Located just two minutes from the Sea to Sky Highway, it has been recognized as one of the best restaurants in Squamish by Restaurantji. The menu features a wide range of mezze, wraps, bowls, and platters with extensive vegan and gluten-free options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Saha Eatery is an active restaurant at 38128 2nd Ave, Squamish, BC with phone 604-567-5888. Takeout is explicitly offered (dedicated 'Take Out Only Meals' section and detailed pickup instructions). Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are extensively documented on the menu with (vg) and (gf) labels throughout, corroborated by OSM diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes. No evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities on either the website or in OSM tags.
